name: @sos-2/real-persistence
description: SOS 2.0 Real Persistence Adapters (Work Order P17-A, persistence/deployment lane): the vendor-backed realization of the frozen P2 live-store provider ports over the REAL free-tier stack of docs/deployment/free-tier-plan.md. Neon PostgreSQL (HTTP SQL proxy + management API) backs PostgresStoreAdapter as the SOLE CANONICAL durable store; Upstash Redis (REST) backs RedisCoordinationAdapter for cache/idempotency/leases ONLY — NEVER canonical (flushAll is the never-canonical proof operation and every key is tier-prefixed per the P3 namespace contract); Cloudflare R2 (S3-compatible API, AWS SigV4 implemented on node:crypto — ZERO external dependencies) backs ObjectStoreAdapter for write-once immutable content-addressed objects under tier-prefixed keys. Honest provider states (CONNECTED/UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE/DEGRADED) come from REAL probes only; the frozen port health() surface maps probed outcomes to AVAILABLE/UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN without ever fabricating success. Every network call goes through ONE injectable FetchPort seam (zero ambient network in package src); credentials are env-only, injected at the composition boundary, and outcomes/notes/telemetry/evidence carry env NAMES only — never values (transcripts are redacted through the lane corpus). Deterministic reference-mode: the adapter logic runs offline against a scripted FetchPort (injected clocks; no ambient env); network happens only in the env-gated integration suite (RUN_REAL=1, tests/real-persistence). The P3 infra/deployment configuration contracts are carried STRUCTURALLY (the frozen P8 body-runtimes precedent — that package is zero-dependency with no module entry point) and the field-for-field alignment is pinned by test in tests/real-persistence.
